title: Ripley boys' soccer defeats Poca, Ravenswood and Parkersburg South | Jackson Star and Herald - Ripley and Ravenswood | wvnews.com
text:
RIPLEY, W.Va. (WV News) - Ripley enjoyed wins over Poca, Ravenswood and Parkersburg South on the pitch in recent matches.
The Vikings handed Poca a 7-0 defeat.
Che Wilkinson and Brenton Scholl each had two goals.
Cade McCoy, Eli Jenkins and Chase Gandee each had two.
Jenkins, Wilkinson, McCoy, Isaiah Bowen and Scholl all were credited with an assist.
Zander Kestner and Ian McCauley each were part of the shutout as keepers. McCauley had a save.
In a 6-1 win over Ravenswood, Wilkinson, Scholl, Bowen, McCoy and Jenkins all had goals.
Of the Poca and Ravenswood matches, Wilkinson said, "We had a chance to work on some small things in these two matches and get a lot of kids some playing time. It's important we develop some more depth on our bench the deeper we get into the season. We've stayed away from injuries in the regular season so far, but you want to have the next player ready to step in."
In a 5-0 win over Parkersburg South, McCoy had a hat trick with three goals. Scholl and Eli Jenkins each had one goal.
"This was the first game we played as a team and not a group of individuals," said head coach Bob Wilkinson. "It was 1-0 at half and they came out strong in the second half, 10 minutes into the half we scored two quick goals to put the contest out of reach. Zander Kestner was strong in the net again with a clean sheet."
